citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020). geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0231866

districts.use: district units (FRRIS v1.1 exposure by administrative level)
districts.source: Tanzania National Bureau of Statistics / UN OCHA ROSA
districts.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY 3.0 IGO)

region_lookup.use: district -> region assignment (district_region.csv); regions are built by grouping districts, never drawn from this layer
region_lookup.source: Tanzania National Bureau of Statistics / UN OCHA ROSA (HDX cod-ab-tza)
region_lookup.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY 3.0 IGO)

district_region_table.method: each district assigned to the region (gbHumanitarian ADM1) with the largest area overlap, in an equal-area projection; minimum overlap 100.0% for all 170 districts
district_region_table.status: PENDING OWNER APPROVAL (shown 2026-11-20); not used by any run until approved

not_used: gbOpen TZA ADM1 (OSM 2015, 30 regions) and any ADM3 layer: owner decision 2026-11-20. Wards come only from client-supplied NBS boundaries.
